statement_map.email_excerpt: Your new leads from your funnel form had stopped reaching your CRM about three days ago, so here is a summary of where things stand.
Following our guidance, you corrected the webhook URL and saved it, then submitted a test lead and confirmed it now shows up in your CRM, and new leads are flowing again.
We found a typo in the webhook URL in your webhook settings.
We will arrange for the missed leads from the last three days to be resent to your CRM, and we will message you once that is done.
